description: Breitbandprojekt - Rhein-Kreis Neuss is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.rhein-kreis-neuss.de. The broadband project represents the individual clusters (realization areas) in the Rhein-Kreis Neuss. In addition, the areas of the development areas and the schools concerned are displayed. The basis for this is a supply of high-performance broadband connections. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Broadband project - Rhein-Kreis Neuss" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Grevenbroich, effizent, Rommerskirchen, Internet, Korschenbroich, Neuss. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
